info.name: OTUS - Microservices Final Project - Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j + Chaos Monkey) - k8s
info.description: Circuit Breaker scenarios: fault injection via /actuator/chaosmonkey (ADMIN only), slow failures with retries, fast 503 CIRCUIT_BREAKER_OPEN when the circuit is open, recovery and control orders (BILLING/WAREHOUSE/DELIVERY blocks). K8s mirror: public routes go through the ingress (baseUrl); chaos endpoints are NOT published by the ingress, so chaosBillingUrl/chaosWarehouseUrl/chaosDeliveryUrl expect kubectl port-forward targets - the k8s run of this collection is postponed.
